public_rationale: Claude had a documented web-search mechanism before the post and used retrieved information to inform responses. The earlier LaMDA paper also described explicit grounding tools. Under the ordinary functional reading of “doesn’t even try,” the categorical claim is false. This finding does not establish human-like understanding or sentience.
limitations: The result depends on reading the statement as a claim about system functionality.
The web-search page includes a later May update; the evidence used concerns its original March functionality.
External grounding can coexist with next-token generation.

statement.excerpt: Software like LaMDA simply doesn’t; it doesn’t even try to connect to the world at large, it just tries to be the best version of autocomplete it can be, by predicting what words best fit a given context.
